ROOT DRYING, BRITTLE COMPONENT RELEASE AND FUNCTIONAL MAGNET RECOVERY CONTRACTS
13 November 2026 Brisbane. Conditional physical/source/cost constructions only.

Actual scope
The complete available mineral-drying return and its full issued question were read, including all saved top-level visible activity. Its native final identity/text/prefix, nested commands, web pages, files and helper contents remain unverified or unread. Linked PDF/ZIP files were not collected, identified, executed or substituted. The following independent calculations use ROOT-written analytic code, not producer code. They do not qualify materials or constitute an experiment. Source failures do not establish physical impossibility.

Owned executable:
ROOT_DRYING_LEDGER_AND_INTACT_MAGNET_RELEASE_SCREEN_20261113.py
Its same-stem JSON is the executed numerical output. Every hypothetical material parameter is labeled introduced. An assertion checks displayed ledger arithmetic and finite diagnostics, not an experimental performance claim.

1. Service boundary and the actual drying construction
The issued useful operation starts at the co-located industrial slurry handoff. The reference DME process buys .1288 kWh per kg removed feed-origin water, has estimated installed capital2.563M USD and costs48.07 USD/t removed water at40 USD/MWh. The favorable larger-contact/lower-approach construction is .0778 kWh/kg,3.260M capital and51.70 USD/t. That favorable PROCESS figure conditionally satisfies the .08 energy limit at the industrial handoff; this fact is retained. It does not satisfy the capital, whole-cost, relative-advantage or unmeasured powder-quality requirements.

Laboratory rewetting of purchased powder is a separate paid preparation route. The displayed .01045 preparation allowance gives .08825 when added to the rounded .0778; the producer's .08820 uses its underlying unrounded values. This rounding difference is not a new physical inconsistency. Common upstream manufacture of actual industrial slurry is not retroactively inserted into the specified process-energy target. Reagent and equipment preparation energy remains physically allocated separately, with no second financial electricity charge where already included in purchase prices.
